messages.subject: Further Developments on Shiny Dashboarding
parts:
I wanted to share the work I've been doing extending Winston Chang's initial work with Dashboards in Shiny. I forked his initial code and have been able to flush out some of the code and create a few new widgets, as well.

You can see an example online here:
http://spark.rstudio.com/trestletech/ShinyDash-Sample/

Features include:
 - Gridster integration allows for interactive drag-and-drop functionality on flexibly sized widgets.
 - Rickshaw integration for live line and area plots with multiple series, and interactive hover/legend abilities
 - JustGage integration to provide support for animated gauges.
 - Weather widget
 - Custom HTML output widgets which can display any text/numeric values
 - A concept of "State" on each widget which can control their presentation (warning, error, etc.)

The source code behind the example is available on GitHub:
https://github.com/trestletech/ShinyDash-Sample

If you're interested in following the development of the package itself, you can do so here:
https://github.com/trestletech/ShinyDash

I'm all ears if you have any suggestions on new widgets or additional capabilities that you would find useful in this package.
